entry_gate: G10 major completion report and audit saved before derivative audio export
selection: G10 source manifest speaker order:first eligible utterance per each of4 speakers. Use OOFFICE,point relative-80,SNR0; assign target angles[-40,20,70,-40] in that order. No score/hypothesis based case selection.
waveform_export: Full clips only,mono16k FLOAT WAV,one common page-wide attenuation if any output peak exceeds1; no per-model gain matching,trimming or overwriting source waves
display: Labels and official transcript visible,ASR texts behind optional details. Explicit researcher-assisted nonblind listening,not a formal perceptual experiment or automatic word-deletion proof.
human_review: No feedback inferred or requested during unattended run; optional follow-up after user returns
note: This auxiliary UI rule was fixed while SE inference was already ongoing and before ASR started; not claimed preregistered before all G10 computation. Does not affect method/weight/data/metric analysis.
